WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName,
         AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate,
         COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS m
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS overall_rate
  FROM media_rates
)
SELECT AVG(mr.byte_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(mr.track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(mr.byte_rate - o.overall_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM media_rates AS mr
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE mr.byte_rate > o.overall_rate
